sources.role: Manufacturer primary source explicitly linked by NCCP; current revision postdates NCCP2024. Supplied unlicensed product and pharmacy applicability require confirmation.

schedule.schedule_summary: Lomustine 130 mg/m² as a single oral Day 1 dose, maximum 280 mg, every 42 days. No daily dosing or fixed cycle-count promise. Review prior alkylating therapy, previous nadirs and total exposure before every course.
schedule.duration_text: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity, subject to cumulative exposure and consultant review; never repeat a course before six weeks.

components.note: Maximum 280 mg per course; single Day 1 dose, then no further lomustine until at least six weeks and approval of the next course. Prior alkylator exposure may require a lower prescribed dose. Current SmPC cumulative maximum 1000 mg/m² requires review of prior exposure and the proposed dose.

schedule.administration: Swallow capsules whole; do not open. The medac SmPC prefers bedtime or three hours after meals. Dispense only the prescribed course and confirm the next permitted dose date. Suspected extra dosing needs urgent clinical advice; never repeat a dose after vomiting or take an extra dose without the treating team.

baseline: NCCP: PFTs where clinically indicated for high pulmonary risk; current product SmPC: baseline pulmonary function studies
during: NCCP: regular FBC, renal and liver profile
Current product SmPC: CBC preferably weekly for at least six weeks after every dose, with longer follow-up until recovery when needed
NCCP: PFTs if clinically indicated in high-risk patients; product SmPC requests frequent pulmonary function testing during treatment
before_each_course: Current ANC/platelets and, for product safety, WBC recovery
Previous-course WBC/platelet nadirs, actual prior dose, episode reductions and at least 42 days since previous dose
Lifetime cumulative exposure including the proposed course; current product maximum 1000 mg/m²
Prescription verification: maximum 130 mg/m² and NCCP 280 mg total cap
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Brain imaging and other disease assessments follow the consultant plan; NCCP does not prescribe a fixed MRI interval or tumour-marker panel.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00805 v 2 p 3: oral moderate-to-high emetogenic potential. Confirm an antiemetic plan around the single lomustine dose; do not imply daily chemotherapy or a 42-day daily antiemetic prescription.
other_supportive_care: Lomustine is a single oral dose onDay 1; do not take it daily. No repeat course before at least six weeks and team approval.
Confirm the prescribed capsule strengths and the dispensing plan; the NCCP regimen notes unlicensed supply.
Swallow capsules whole. Product SmPC advises bedtime or three hours after meals; confirm instructions for the supplied product.
Blood counts may fall late, especially 4–6 weeks after the dose, and can recover later than the planned next course. Attend weekly blood tests as instructed even when feeling well.

Confirm the contraception plan with oncology pharmacy: NCCP states six months for men and women; January 2026 medac SmPC states seven months for women and four months for men. Do not shorten existing advice without the team.
Discuss sperm preservation and fertility before treatment.
Report new breathlessness/cough, fever, bruising/bleeding, jaundice or suspected accidental extra doses urgently.
Avoid live vaccines unless the specialist team confirms safety; the product SmPC advises no live vaccines until at least three months after treatment.

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP assigns no dose to platelets 80–<100 with ANC ≥1.0. Flag specialist review across the entire fractional interval. A previous hold requires recovery to platelets≥100.

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP uses ANC ≥1.0 and platelets≥100; the product SmPC requires WBC ≥4.0 and platelets≥100 before repeat dosing. WBC is not ANC. Resolve any mismatch before a further course.

source_conflicts.resolution: The SmPC 70% row starts at platelets 24,000/mm³, overlapping its 50% row below 25,000/mm³. Values 24–<25×10⁹/L and discordant WBC/platelet rows need source clarification; no definitive percentage is calculated.

source_conflicts.resolution: Renal 75% refers to the original dose; SmPC nadir 70/50% refers to prior dose; non-haematological reduction 50% and subsequent full-dose restoration require clinical interpretation. Do not multiply percentages or erase prior reductions.

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP makes PFTs conditional on high risk, whereas the product SmPC requests baseline and frequent ongoing PFTs. Retain both labelled recommendations and confirm local plan. FVC/DLCO <70% is a risk signal, not an automatic DLCO <60% withholding threshold.

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP says six months for men and women; January 2026 product SmPC says seven months for women and four months for men. Confirm product-specific pharmacy advice; do not publish an unqualified shared duration or silently shorten existing advice.

passport: Single administration per course; record the dose date and earliest next permitted dose date with team approval
Record all prior lomustine exposure, including any earlier PCV/CLV or combination regimens, for pharmacy review
Record weeklyCBC appointments, platelet/WBC recovery and next-review arrangements
Document pulmonary symptoms and the agreedPFT plan
Record steroid/antiseizure medicines, seizure plan, neurological baseline, functional goals and carer contacts
BrainMRI timing belongs to the treating plan; no mandatory generic tumour-marker panel
urgent: Possible extra capsule/course: seek urgent clinical advice immediately; delayed toxicity can occur even if initially well
Fever or feeling unwell, unexpected bruising/bleeding
New seizure, weakness, speech/vision change or marked confusion
Persistent vomiting, jaundice or other severe symptoms
anatomy: Lungs: rare pulmonary fibrosis; report symptoms
Reproductive system: fertility, pregnancy and source-specific contraception advice
indication_boundary: Recurrent malignant glioma. The glioma patient reference can support education but not broaden local indication or replace NCCP dosing rules.
